thread:
elaine: FYI Novus wants us to onboard an SG-edge marketplace SKU for a joint pilot. asking for quota + marketplace entitlement + SI integration checklist. timeline: pilot customers in 3 weeks.
pete: do we have a SKU draft from Novus? need to check pricing and whether it's BYOK or redwood-managed KMS.
ryan: Novus sent placeholder SKU: NOVUS-SG-EDGE-01. they plan to use L40S-equivalent GPUs (4 units for week 0). also will need private link for SI.
sophie: legal will want key routing details. if it's BYOK -> faster. if we hold keys, we need the appendix signed.
elaine: Novus prefers us to host KMS for the pilot for simpler onboarding, but they can do BYOK for production. we should push for BYOK in the MOU.
pete: ops constraints: SG region requires a minimal egress quota of 5TB/mo and a control-plane vCPU quota of 32. network team flagged port 443 whitelisting for Novus SI.
ryan: confirmed: request 4 L40S equiv GPUs, 32 vCPUs, 5TB egress. will set autoscaler bounds to 12 GPUs after week 2.
sophie: I'll add clause: 3.1 (key custody) + 9.4 (incident notif 48h). also need a statement on data residency for SE-Asia customers.
elaine: marketing asked to time the joint announcement with the marketplace listing. prefer announcement after pilot completes positive QA. Novus wants co-branded launch comms.
pete: deploy-bot opened ticket: #ENT-7391 - SG marketplace entitlement + KMS flow doc (assignee: ryan). ETA 2026-04-06.
elaine: can someone intro me to Novus PM? contact is @maria_novus. I'll coordinate the co-marketing brief and calendar invites.
ryan: +1 will upload KMS diagram and network diagram to the ticket.
sophie: +1 will review MOU today and post redlines.
pete: I'll file the quota escalation request with cloud marketplace ops once the vCPU/GPU numbers are final.
elaine: quick vote: reply with "+1" to greenlight hosting pilot with Novus-managed keys OR "BYOK" to insist on customer-managed keys for pilot. need decision by EOD Tuesday so marketplace listing doesn't slip.
ryan: +1 (ok to host keys for pilot; push BYOK for production)
sophie: BYOK (legal prefers customer keys even for pilot if Novus can support)
pete: +1 (ops can support hosting keys but document requirements)
elaine: thanks everyone. I'll send intro email to @maria_novus and tie in marketing/legal/ops. reminder: entitlement sync on calendar for 2026-04-05 09:00 SGT.
